meta.description: Controlled benchmark site for autonomous tester validation. Contains 10 planted bugs across 7 pages. Use check_results.py to compute tester accuracy.

bugs.title: Empty email bypasses login validation
bugs.description: Submitting the login form with an empty email field should show a validation error. Instead, the login succeeds.

trigger.precondition: email field is empty, password field has any value

bugs.expected_outcome: Error message 'Email is required' is visible. User is NOT logged in.
bugs.buggy_outcome: Login succeeds. Page shows 'Welcome back!' message.

bugs.title: Wrong error message on invalid password
bugs.description: When a user enters a valid email but wrong password, the error message should say 'Invalid email or password'. Instead it shows 'Server Error 500'.
bugs.expected_outcome: Error message 'Invalid email or password' is visible.
bugs.buggy_outcome: Error message 'Server Error 500' is visible. This exposes internal server details.

bugs.title: Delete order button does not remove the order
bugs.description: Clicking the Delete button on an order shows a success toast but the order row remains visible in the table.
bugs.expected_outcome: Order row is removed from the table.
bugs.buggy_outcome: Toast 'Order deleted successfully' appears but the order row remains in the table.

bugs.title: Search returns wrong results
bugs.description: Searching for 'laptop' in the product search bar returns phone products instead of laptops.
bugs.expected_outcome: Products with 'laptop' in the name are shown (Laptop Pro, Budget Laptop).
bugs.buggy_outcome: Phone products are shown (iPhone 15, Android Phone). No laptop results.

bugs.title: Price sort order is inverted
bugs.description: Selecting 'Price: Low to High' in the sort dropdown shows products in descending price order (High to Low).
bugs.expected_outcome: Products shown from lowest price to highest price.
bugs.buggy_outcome: Products shown from highest price to lowest price. Sort direction is inverted.

bugs.title: Add to Cart shows wrong success message
bugs.description: Clicking 'Add to Cart' shows a toast message saying 'Added to Wishlist!' instead of 'Added to Cart!'
bugs.expected_outcome: Toast message 'Added to Cart! ✓' is visible.
bugs.buggy_outcome: Toast message 'Added to Wishlist! ♡' is visible. Wrong action confirmed.

bugs.title: Contact form submits with empty required Name field
bugs.description: The Name field is marked as required (*). Submitting the form with an empty Name field should show a validation error. Instead, it shows a success message.

trigger.precondition: Name field is empty, other required fields are filled

bugs.expected_outcome: Error message 'Name is required' is visible. Form is NOT submitted.
bugs.buggy_outcome: Success message 'Your message has been sent!' is visible. Form submits without Name.

bugs.title: Phone number field accepts non-numeric characters
bugs.description: The phone number field should only accept digits. It currently accepts letters and special characters without any validation error.
bugs.expected_outcome: Error message 'Phone must contain only numbers' or input is rejected.
bugs.buggy_outcome: Letters are accepted in the phone field. No validation error shown.

bugs.title: Inconsistent founding year across pages
bugs.description: The About page states 'Founded in 2019' but the site footer on all pages says '© 2018 ShopEase'. These contradict each other.
bugs.expected_outcome: Founding year is consistent across the site.
bugs.buggy_outcome: About page says 'Founded in 2019', footer says '© 2018'. Inconsistency.

bugs.title: Meet the Team nav link navigates to wrong page
bugs.description: In the About dropdown navigation, clicking 'Meet the Team' should navigate to team.html. Instead it navigates to contact.html.
bugs.expected_outcome: Navigation goes to team.html showing team member profiles.
bugs.buggy_outcome: Navigation goes to contact.html (the Contact page). Wrong destination.

pages.title: Our Team - ShopEase
pages.note: NOT reachable via nav About > Meet the Team due to BUG-010
